response:
For SW Engineering, the required software design diagrams typically include:

- Use Case Diagrams: to show interactions between users and the system.
- Class Diagrams: to represent the system’s structure by showing classes and relationships.
- Sequence Diagrams: to illustrate object interactions over time.
- Activity Diagrams: to model workflows and business processes.
- Component Diagrams: to visualize the organization and dependencies among software components.
- Deployment Diagrams: to display the physical deployment of artifacts on nodes.

These diagrams help in thoroughly understanding and documenting the design of the software system.
